prompt: Complete StreamStats with stream pipelines: sumOfSquaresOfEvens sums the squares of the even numbers, and upperSorted returns a new uppercased, alphabetically sorted list.
explanation: Stream pipelines describe the computation declaratively: filter drops the odd numbers, map squares the survivors, and reduce folds them into a single sum starting from 0. upperSorted never touches the input list -- sorted() orders the stream elements and collect builds a brand-new list, which is why the tests can verify the input stayed unchanged.
hints: Start each method with the list's stream() and chain operations on it.
For the sum: filter keeps the evens (n % 2 == 0), map squares them, and reduce (or an IntStream sum) totals them.
For upperSorted: map with String::toUpperCase, then sorted(), then collect into a new list with Collectors.toList().
